about_the_game:
"In Blind Trust, communication isn't optional — it's your only way to survive."

Blind Trust is a 2–5 player online co-op platformer that challenges your teamwork like never before. One player sees a world full of deadly traps and hazards, while the others see only a peaceful landscape. The sighted guide the blind through tense platforming challenges using voice, timing, and trust.

Your goal: escape a burning city by making your way to the jail on the far side of the map — the only safe haven left.

When a player falls, everyone fails — the game resets, the roles rotate, and the challenge begins again from a fresh perspective.

In addition to navigating deadly terrain, your team must work together to solve a complex maze by driving cars with chaotic physics, requiring coordination and skill from all players.

Use your ability to slow time to survive tight situations and master the art of communication under pressure.

  • 2–5 Player Online Co-Op – Teamwork and trust drive every moment. For the smoothest gameplay, the player with the more powerful PC should host the session.

  • Asymmetric Vision – One player sees danger; others see calm.

  • One Falls, All Fall – A single mistake resets the whole team.

  • Dynamic Role Rotation – Each reset changes who leads.

  • Chaotic Car Maze – Solve a challenging maze together, controlling unpredictable vehicles.

  • Slow Time Mechanic – Briefly slow down time to avoid disaster.

  • Intense & Unforgettable – Experience a rollercoaster of chaos, teamwork, and laughs.

One leader. Many followers. One mistake — and it all resets. Can your team survive Blind Trust?

name: Blind Trust: The City

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Minimum: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Doesn't support VR
  • Additional Notes: Always make sure the player with the more powerful PC is the host (listen server) for the smoothest gameplay experience. A high-speed internet connection and a stable connection between players are required to play, as this is only a multiplayer game. Hosting sessions may also require more RAM than joining — 16 GB is the minimum, but 32 GB is recommended if hosting.

short_description: "In Blind Trust, communication isn't optional — it's your only way to survive." A chaotic 2–5 player co-op platformer where only one player can see and must guide blindfolded teammates through deadly obstacles. If anyone fails, everyone dies and the leader role shifts.
